findings.reason: The cited evidence shows the correlation between user/traffic spikes and latency/PRB, but does not prove the surge was the cause of the congestion.
T1, T7, and ALR-0037 all confirm the specific metrics and the 19:00-21:00 timeframe for S-TUN-004.
T7 explicitly lists S-TUN-016 and S-TUN-018 with 'no deviation' for all metrics in the window.
T3, T4, and T6 all report no external events, maintenance, or changes for the specified nodes and time window.
